children: Crypto stocks are trading lower, ahead of a key procedural vote the Senate is set to hold on the Clarity Act, which would represent the first regulatory framework expected to usher in wider acceptance of crypto.
Shares of Circle Internet fell 8.2%, to $89.39, on Tuesday. At the same time, Coinbase shares were down 6.7%, to $178.72, and Strategy shares were off 5%, to $130.05.
Shares of Riot Platforms were down 4.2%, to $20.08. Robinhood shares were recently trading 3.7% lower, at $110.14, while MARA Holdings shares declined 2.6%, to $11.20.
The legislation faces several challenges, including disagreements over ethics language that would prevent government officials from profiting off digital assets, The Wall Street Journal reported.
